chris_marketing: FYI morning alert: inbound assignment median up to ~8m for NA. Noticed after the product webinar surge. :coffee:
alex_salesops: Any traces? enrichment timing or RR worker saturation?
maria_revops: We saw enrichment GET 504 spikes + RR retries backing off. Sample lead 00D-90001 shows claim success after ~6 retries.
chris_marketing: sample trace: POST /enrich 200 @10:05:01Z; GET /enrich/00D-90001 504 @10:05:03Z; RR claim attempts until 10:13:20Z.
jin_infra: Current retry policy holds claim while waiting for enrichment. Proposal: implement a fast-assign fallback after 7s with minimal fields (email, region) then patch when enrich returns. Adds a parallel low-touch path for lead_score < 20.
tia_support: +1. Please add an on-call runbook entry for median_claim > 7m to page revops + infra with diagnostics `kubectl logs -l app=rr-worker -n routing --since=1h`.
alex_salesops: Can we canary it? 1% traffic -> fallback, check median/P95 and SDr conversion.
maria_revops: I'll update HS->SF mapping doc to reflect low-touch and schedule a 24h re-enrich sweep for fast-assigned leads.
jin_infra: I'll flag + metrics for step=enq|enrich|claim and roll out the 1% canary today.
hs_sync_bot: HubSpot job: 9 retried, 2 failed in last 2h https://internal.hubspot/log/1921234567
chris_marketing: Thanks all, post the experiment brief when live so marketing can monitor conversion impact. :thumbsup:
